name: R-21: external contributions have a PR route and a CLA
summary: CONTRIBUTING describes the route: an accepted pull request is applied in the development tree and exported, and the PR is closed with a link to the exported commit. It names the CLA. CLA.md exists. cla.yml runs contributor-assistant/github-action@v2.6.1 against CLA.md.

assertions.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 describe applying the PR in the development tree; the PR itself is not merged directly.
CONTRIBUTING.md:24 'Agreement (CLA). A bot comments on your first pull request'.
